articles.title: Figma Employee Sues Company Over Alleged Harassment
articles.summary: A current employee is suing Figma and its CEO, alleging that the company forced her to confront individuals responsible for sexual harassment and discrimination within the workplace.

articles.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Ship for AI Code Review
articles.summary: To address the growing volume of AI-generated code, Anthropic has introduced new developer tools. These allow AI agents to handle routine tasks such as reviewing, fixing, and approving code changes automatically.

articles.title: Supertake Raises $20M for AI Stock Portfolios
articles.summary: Startup Supertake has secured $20 million in funding to build a platform where AI agents translate users' market predictions into actionable stock portfolios without requiring direct stock-picking skills.

articles.title: Megaspeed Faces Potential U.S. Blacklist Following Scandal
articles.summary: Megaspeed, central to a recent corporate scandal, appears headed for a U.S. blacklist. The company would be barred from doing business with American firms unless they obtain a special federal license.

articles.title: Google Search AI Mode Integrates Drive and Wallet
articles.summary: Google is enhancing its AI Mode with Personal Intelligence features, allowing the assistant to tap into user data within Google Drive, Wallet, and the Gemini app for more personalized responses.

articles.title: Amazon Acquires Decart AI Optimization Tech for $7.5B
articles.summary: Amazon is acquiring Decart's AI optimization technology and its research team in a massive $7.5 billion deal as the company prepares to roll out its new Trainium chips.

articles.title: Meta Abandons 2030 Net-Zero Carbon Goal
articles.summary: Meta has dropped its 2030 net-zero emissions target in its latest sustainability report, a controversial decision that could create significant ripples throughout the broader tech industry.

articles.title: Search Alternative Kagi Launches New Email Service
articles.summary: Kagi, known for its paid search alternative and browser, has launched a public beta for Kagi Mail. The new email service promises no surveillance, zero ads, open standards, and no vendor lock-in.

articles.title: Hacker Behind GTA VI Leaks Sentenced and Released
articles.summary: Arion Kurtaj, the hacker responsible for leaking early GTA VI footage from Rockstar Games, was sentenced to seven years in prison but has been released on license.

articles.title: Ladybird Web Browser Launches Alpha Testing Phase
articles.summary: After more than four years of independent development, Ladybird has launched its alpha version on macOS and Linux, making it the first web browser in years built with a completely new engine.

articles.title: Apple Watch Series 12 Drops to Record Low Price
articles.summary: The 42mm Apple Watch Series 12 with Wi-Fi and GPS has dropped to a new all-time low price of $299 at major retailers like Amazon and Walmart, offering $100 in savings.

articles.title: AI Data Centers Complicate UN Climate Talks at COP31
articles.summary: Delegates at the chaotic COP31 climate conference in Turkey struggled to balance global electrification goals with the massive surge in electricity consumption driven by power-hungry AI data centers.

articles.title: Apple Renews Hit Comedy Series Ted Lasso for Season 5
articles.summary: Following what Apple describes as a record-breaking season four debut, the streaming platform has officially renewed its popular comedy series Ted Lasso for a fifth season.

articles.title: States Sue SpaceX Over Grok AI Image Generation
articles.summary: Multiple state attorneys general are suing SpaceX, alleging that its Grok AI tool generates harmful content, including child sexual abuse material and revenge porn, despite company screening claims.

articles.title: Reports Warn Russia May Test Nuclear Weapon in Space
articles.summary: Intelligence reports suggest Russia could launch a nuclear weapon into orbit soon, a detonation that experts warn could cause the rapid and sudden destruction of thousands of satellites.

articles.title: COP31 Climate Summit Ends Without Consensus Deal
articles.summary: For the first time since 2009, the UN climate conference COP31 concluded without a consensus agreement as participating countries remained deeply divided over fossil fuels and climate finance.
